scope: Header and authorized definitions only; no proof/provider/source acceptance claim; no Lean execution

shared_semantics.space: ℝ with its usual absolute-value norm
shared_semantics.loss_index: definitions ignore index; quantified prefix facts cover only i=0
shared_semantics.effectiveDomain: {x | f x < top}; alone does not exclude bottom
shared_semantics.minimum: IsMinOn f V p = forall z in V, f p <= f z; membership separate
shared_semantics.toReal: finite embedded reals map to themselves; both infinities map to zero

tight.name: Tight.tight_dual_stability_at_nonminimizer

definitions.losses: losses i x = (2*x : ℝ) embedded in EReal, for all i
definitions.support: 2 times identity continuous linear map; support x=2*x

conjuncts_in_order: ∀ z ∈ feasible, (losses 0 0).toReal - hint 0 + support (z - 0) ≤ (losses 0 z).toReal - hint z
limits: No assertion that comparator -2 is a minimizer

zero_curvature.name: ZeroCurvature.zero_curvature_division_is_false

definitions.losses: losses i x = x embedded in EReal, for all i
definitions.currentObjective: x embedded in EReal on [-1,1], top outside
definitions.support: identity continuous linear map; support x=x

conjuncts_in_order: ∀ i < (0 : ℕ) + 1, ∀ x, losses i x ≠ ⊥

∀ x ∈ feasible, ∀ y ∈ feasible, ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a < 1 → currentObjective (a • x + (1 - a) • y) ≤ (a : EReal) * currentObjective x + ((1 - a : ℝ) : EReal) * currentObjective y - ((((0 : ℝ) / 2) * a * (1 - a) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : EReal)
∀ z ∈ feasible, (losses 0 0).toReal - hint 0 + support (z - 0) ≤ (losses 0 z).toReal - hint z

quantifier_scopes.conjunct_2: i natural with i<1, then all real x globally
quantifier_scopes.conjunct_3: i natural with i<1, then domain membership for all feasible x
quantifier_scopes.conjunct_4: x, membership; y, membership; real a; 0<a; a<1; EReal inequality

zero_curvature.curvature: zero; affine equality on feasible interval; no strict positivity
limits: Counterexample only to permitting zero in this quotient under the listed conditions
Does not contradict a strictly-positive-curvature theorem
No general impossibility of alternative zero-curvature bounds

finiteness_and_membership.losses: all defined losses are finite at every real x, not only on their feasible intervals
finiteness_and_membership.gap_points: explicit membership and finite EReal objective equalities justify finite toReal interpretation
finiteness_and_membership.outside_feasible: current objectives are top; their toReal is zero and cannot represent the extended-real order
finiteness_and_membership.nonempty: both intervals explicitly contain 0 and the supplied negative comparator

comparison: Tight asserts attained positive-denominator bound 2≤2 at parameter 1 and prediction point that is not a current-objective minimizer. ZeroCurvature asserts gap 1 and zero quotient at parameter 0, with failure ¬(1≤0), alongside its listed convexity, finiteness, zero-curvature, minimum, support, and feasibility facts.
